title: SMProfile-TestResult payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/quality/test-result.json 1.0.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

description.description: What was tested, as the source says it.

expiration.description: Until when the result holds (a qualification or a capability test runs out).

result.description: The evaluated criterion result (B2MML TestResult.EvaluatedCriterionResult, free text there): Passed, Failed, or NotMeasured — a test that was never measured is neither a pass nor a fail. A source maps its words with valueMap.

person_ref.description: The tested object when it is a person (pseudonymous id) — a qualification test (TESTS).

machine_ref.description: The tested object when it is a machine (Equipment) — an equipment capability test (TESTS).

tool_ref.description: The tested object when it is a tool (physical asset) — a physical asset capability test (TESTS).

parent_test_result_ref.description: The parent result this one is part of (PART_OF).
